## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change, in a `*.test.ts` file next to the code
- [ ] A changeset is added if a published package changed (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] No client names, private project names or details from real client work; examples use fictional domains
- [ ] Stack-agnostic: no framework, bundler or platform is named as an instruction rather than an example
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed
